method: Every live fact was read (reg-dump.txt). Decisions are in reg-decisions.json; patches in reg-patches/ (built by reg_build.py, which checks every display against normalize_text of the quotes). Demand statuses merged by reg_demand.py.
rules_applied: Duplicates: superseded when two facts quote the same sentence of the same page (kept the fact with the longer or more direct span and the better displays); FAQ facts that state the same thing as a guide sentence on another page were kept, because the FAQ quick-fire section needs FAQ quotes.

Composite facts that only repeat sentences which have their own single-sentence facts were superseded (s3-encryption-options-overview, s3-presigned-url-time-limited-without-bucket-policy-change, s3-replication-asynchronous-new-objects).
Bullets of superseded and rejected duplicates were merged into the kept fact.

Displays without a number: a verbatim phrase of at most 8 words from one quote (RULINGS 2026-10-11); 286 long or paraphrased displays were replaced and 5 dropped (12 new displays added); displays held only by the claim were replaced or dropped (s3-private-by-default private-short, s3-bucket-no-size-limit count, BlockPublicPolicy).
Qualifiers: scope filled on 180 facts that had none (mostly the FAQ lens).

Claims cut to what the quotes support: s3-faq-archive-classes-summary (Instant Retrieval was not in its quote), s3-int-tiering-move-back (no list of request types in the quote), s3-cors-rule-match-origin-method-headers (ACL sentence left to s3-cors-rule-matching).
s3-directory-bucket-unsupported-features: evidence replaced by the whole list quote (72 words, whole lines) so that every feature named in the claim is in the evidence.
s3-lifecycle-small-object-default: took the object size filter sentence of a superseded duplicate.
s3-faq-encryption-sse-s3-base: took the change items of the superseded s3-encryption-options-overview and volatility frequently-changing.

added.s3-directory-bucket-read-tps-quota: directory-buckets-overview quota row: up to 200,000 read TPS per directory bucket (default, increase through Support)
added.s3-directory-bucket-write-tps-quota: directory-buckets-overview quota row: up to 100,000 write TPS per directory bucket; s3-faq-directory-bucket-tps (2 million TPS) now scoped as the maximum the bucket type supports

rejected.s3-faq-mrap-17-regions: FAQ says up to 17 Regions; the General Reference quota table says 20 Regions per Multi-Region Access Point, not adjustable (kept: s3-mrap-regions-max)

conflicts.cf-0175: kept s3-int-tiering-move-back (the other fact was already superseded)

searches_this_stage: 'December 15, 2025' (scope all): no Glacier vault closure row
Transfer Acceleration with TLS/encrypt/HTTPS (scope all): nothing that says the accelerated path is encrypted
Multi-Region Access Point Region count: only the quota row (20) and the FAQ (17)
directory bucket TPS: quota rows found and adopted

for_the_writers: Several facts are not examinable yet (GA after 2026-07-15): s3-change-lifecycle-ia-no-30-day-minimum-2026-07, s3-change-event-notification-system-tags-2026-07, s3-change-object-lock-variable-retention-2026-09 and the variable-retention part of s3-faq-object-lock-retention-types.

Retrieval times exist from three pages with slightly different wording (docs table, storage-classes marketing page, FAQ): link the docs table facts (s3-archive-retrieval-times-flexible, s3-archive-retrieval-times-deep) in teaching text and the FAQ facts in the FAQ quick-fire.

s3-rtc-guide-99-9-percent-15-minutes (user guide: 99.9 percent within 15 minutes) and s3-replication-time-control-15-minutes (FAQ: designed 99.99 percent, SLA 99.9 percent) are both kept with their own scope.
